note: PX2's effect list candidates: two or three CFXR prefabs per effect kind, best first, chosen from the gallery stills (demo2d/evidence/px2/cfxr-<kind>.jpg) under night lighting at native scale (32 grid pixels per metre). Paths are the manifest's (pixel_assets); the project has them under Assets/Vendor/. All draw best as authored (the top-down camera sees CFXR's 3D effects from the side; laid flat, none looked better, and lightning looked much worse). PX7 picks one per kind and sets its scale, tint, sorting and light cue.

slash arc.path: Assets/JMO Assets/Cartoon FX Remaster/CFXR Prefabs/Impacts/Variants/CFXR Slash (Orange).prefab
slash arc.why: a compact burst of warm slivers; knight_male's skills draw their own arcs, so the effect only needs to add sparks

slash arc.path: Assets/JMO Assets/Cartoon FX Remaster/CFXR Prefabs/Impacts/CFXR Slash (Blue).prefab
slash arc.why: the same in the moonlight's blue

slash arc.path: Assets/JMO Assets/Cartoon FX Remaster/CFXR Prefabs/Impacts/Variants/CFXR Slash (Cross, Orange).prefab
slash arc.why: a taller cross of slivers, for the spin or a combo's last blow

hit spark.path: Assets/JMO Assets/Cartoon FX Remaster/CFXR Prefabs/Impacts/CFXR Hit A (Red).prefab
hit spark.why: a small orange star that reads on dark ground without hiding the grunt it hits

hit spark.path: Assets/JMO Assets/Cartoon FX Remaster/CFXR Prefabs/Impacts/CFXR Hit C.prefab
hit spark.why: white, so a tint can match the blow

hit spark.path: Assets/JMO Assets/Cartoon FX Remaster/CFXR Prefabs/Impacts/CFXR Hit B (Blue).prefab
hit spark.why: a cool star with a glow, for spells' hits

death burst.path: Assets/JMO Assets/Cartoon FX Remaster/CFXR Prefabs/Misc/CFXR Smoke Poof.prefab
death burst.why: a white puff about a grunt's size: undead dissolving, light enough for 400 deaths

death burst.path: Assets/JMO Assets/Cartoon FX Remaster/CFXR Prefabs/Explosions/CFXR Explosion 1.prefab
death burst.why: a flash and fireball, for elites

death burst.path: Assets/JMO Assets/Cartoon FX Remaster/CFXR Prefabs/Misc/CFXR Magic Poof.prefab
death burst.why: the puff with coloured stars, for casters

ring.path: Assets/JMO Assets/Cartoon FX Remaster/CFXR Prefabs/Fire/Variants/CFXR Fire Ring (Blue).prefab
ring.why: a ring of cold flame about 3.5 m across that faces the camera however it's turned

ring.path: Assets/JMO Assets/Cartoon FX Remaster/CFXR Prefabs/Fire/CFXR Fire Ring.prefab
Assets/JMO Assets/Cartoon FX Remaster/CFXR Prefabs/Impacts/CFXR Impact Glowing HDR (Blue).prefab

bolt.path: Assets/JMO Assets/Cartoon FX Remaster/CFXR Prefabs/Fire/CFXR Fireball + Fire Trail.prefab
bolt.why: the projectile: a small fireball whose trail appears once it moves

bolt.path: Assets/JMO Assets/Cartoon FX Remaster/CFXR Prefabs/Fire/Variants/CFXR Fireball Plain.prefab

bolt.path: Assets/JMO Assets/Cartoon FX Remaster/CFXR Prefabs/Impacts/Variants/CFXR Impact Glowing HDR (Blue, No Flare).prefab

lightning.path: Assets/JMO Assets/Cartoon FX Remaster/CFXR Prefabs/Electric/CFXR Lightning Strike + Impact.prefab

lightning.path: Assets/JMO Assets/Cartoon FX Remaster/CFXR Prefabs/Electric/Variants/CFXR Lightning Strike + Impact (Purple).prefab
Assets/JMO Assets/Cartoon FX Remaster/CFXR Prefabs/Electric/CFXR Electric Explosion.prefab

beam.path: Assets/JMO Assets/Cartoon FX Remaster/CFXR Prefabs/Fire/CFXR Fire Breath.prefab
